10.answer: P.O. Box 14, Mbeya. 16 November 2025. Dear Asha, I was deeply saddened to hear of the death of your mother. I remember how kindly she welcomed us when we visited your home. I am thinking of you and your family. If it would help, I can bring you the class notes or come and sit with you after school. Please accept my heartfelt condolences. Your friend, Rehema.
10.explanation: A personal condolence letter acknowledges the loss gently, expresses sympathy and offers appropriate support before closing warmly.
